cards.stem: Dáithí is planning a new garden. The garden has a rectangular planting area, surrounded by a path. The planting area is 20 m long and 12 m wide. The path is 1 m wide. A diagram of the garden is drawn below.
cards.questionText: (a) Find the perimeter of the planting area: Perimeter = 12 + 20 + 12 + 20 = ___ m. (b) Find the area of the planting area: Area = 12 × 20 = ___ m².
solutionQuotes: Any work of relevance in either part

cards.stem: Laoise earns €26 000 per year. She pays tax at the standard rate of 20%.
cards.questionText: Find Laoise’s gross tax.

cards.stem: Laoise earns €26 000 per year. She pays tax at the standard rate of 20%.
cards.questionText: Laoise has a tax credit of €3300. Find her net tax.

cards.stem: Laoise earns €26 000 per year. She pays tax at the standard rate of 20%. Laoise has a tax credit of €3300.
cards.questionText: Laoise also pays PRSI of €1040 and USC of €723. Find her take-home pay.

cards.stem: Geraldine left home at 1:45 p.m. and drove to Longford. That took her 55 minutes. She stopped for a 15-minute break in Longford and then drove on to Westport.
cards.questionText: At what time did she leave Longford?

cards.stem: Geraldine drove from Longford to Westport. The distance from Longford to Westport is 135 km. Her average speed for this part of the journey was 75 km/h.
cards.questionText: How long did it take her to go from Longford to Westport? Give your answer in hours and minutes.

cards.stem: Later, Geraldine drove 135 km back to Longford. She stopped for a break when she had travelled 3/5 of the way.
cards.questionText: How many kilometres had she travelled when she took her break?

cards.stem: A circular disc is cut out of a square piece of metal as shown below. The disc has a radius of 3 cm.
cards.questionText: (i) Find the area of the disc. Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place. (ii) Find the area of metal left after the disc has been removed. Give your answer in cm², correct to 1 decimal place.

cards.stem: Conor has an oil tank in the shape of a cylinder. The length of the cylinder is 205 cm and the radius is 50 cm, as shown. (Note: 1000 cm³ = 1 litre.)
cards.questionText: Find the capacity (volume) of the cylinder. Give your answer in litres, correct to the nearest litre.

cards.stem: Conor has an oil tank in the shape of a cylinder. The length of the cylinder is 205 cm and the radius is 50 cm, as shown. (Note: 1000 cm³ = 1 litre.)
cards.questionText: Conor wants to fill his tank with oil. Oil costs 59 cent per litre. How much does it cost to fill the tank with oil? Give your answer correct to the nearest euro.

cards.stem: Shane surveyed 240 people. He asked them what their favourite Olympic sport was. He then drew the pie chart shown, based on his results. The angles shown are Athletics 126°, Gymnastics 72°, Boxing 54°, and Other x°.
cards.questionText: Find the value of x°, the missing angle. Show all your working out.

cards.stem: Lena is three years older than Rory. In 5 years’ time their ages added together will be 49 years.
cards.questionText: What age is Rory now?

cards.stem: Aisling has a stack of 10 cards with a number printed on one side of each card. The numbers used are 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6. She shuffles the cards, places them on a table with the number side down, and asks Joe to pick a card at random.
cards.questionText: (a) Find the probability that the number Joe picks is a 2. (b) Find the probability that the number Joe picks is an even number. (c) Find the probability that the number Joe picks is a 4 or a 5.

cards.stem: Aisling has a stack of 10 cards with a number printed on one side of each card. The numbers used are 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6. She shuffles the cards, places them on a table with the number side down, and asks Joe to pick a card at random.
cards.questionText: Aisling says: “The probability of picking an odd number is greater than the probability of picking an even number.” Do you agree with Aisling? Give a reason for your answer.

cards.stem: Aisling has a stack of 10 cards with a number printed on one side of each card. The numbers used are 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6. She shuffles the cards, places them on a table with the number side down, and asks Joe to pick a card at random.
cards.questionText: A card is picked from the stack and not put back. It is a 4. A second card is then picked at random from the remaining cards. What is the probability that this second card is a 4?

cards.stem: The graph below shows the relationship between C, the temperature in °C (Celsius) and F, the temperature in °F (Fahrenheit).
cards.questionText: (i) Use the graph to find the value of 60°C in °F. (ii) Use the graph to find the value of 50°F in °C.

cards.stem: The formula below shows the relationship between C, the temperature in °C (Celsius), and F, the temperature in °F (Fahrenheit): C = 5(F − 32)/9.
cards.questionText: Use the formula to show that 212°F is equivalent to 100°C.

cards.stem: The map below shows 2 villages, A and B, in a part of a country in Africa. An Irish aid organisation wants to build a warehouse from which to serve the two villages. The warehouse should be less than 60 km from A and less than 80 km from B. The scale is 1 cm represents 10 km.
cards.questionText: Using your compass, draw and shade in the region on the map where the warehouse could be built.

cards.stem: The diagram below shows a plan of part of a yard. The triangle OXY is the image of the right-angled triangle OAB by an enlargement of centre O and scale factor k = 2·5. The right angle is at A.
cards.questionText: (i) Given that |OA| = 8 m, find |OX|. (ii) Given that |AB| = 6 m, use Pythagoras’ Theorem to calculate |OB|. (iii) Find the area of the triangle OAB.

cards.questionText: (iv) Find the area of the triangle OXY. (v) Hence, or otherwise, find the area of the shape AXYB.
